name: MCP Server
description: FastMCP server providing MCP tool interface for linguistic register detection and translation. Exposes Transmogrifier functionality via stdio transport for Claude Code integration.

types.name: TransmogTranslateResult
types.description: Dictionary returned by transmog_translate, serialized from TranslationResult.model_dump()

types.name: TransmogDetectResult

fields.name: register
fields.description: Detected register enum value as string

types.description: Dictionary returned by transmog_detect containing register classification

functions.name: main
functions.description: MCP server entry point. Initializes FastMCP server with transmogrifier tools and runs stdio transport. Exits with code 1 if mcp.server.fastmcp import fails.
postconditions: FastMCP server instance created with name 'transmogrifier'
Three tools registered: transmog_translate, transmog_detect, transmog_profiles
Transmogrifier instance initialized and stored in closure
Server running on stdio transport (blocking call)
side_effects: Writes to sys.stderr on import failure
Reads from stdin and writes to stdout via stdio transport

functions.name: transmog_translate
functions.description: Translate text to optimal register for the target model. Decorated as @mcp.tool() for MCP exposure. Uses Transmogrifier.translate() and returns serialized result.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Target model identifier for register optimization

inputs.name: target_register
inputs.description: Explicit target register name (overrides model-based detection)

error_cases.name: invalid_register
error_cases.condition: target_register string not valid Register enum value

preconditions: _t (Transmogrifier instance) must be initialized in closure
postconditions: Returns dictionary serialized from TranslationResult via model_dump()
If target_register provided, config.target_register set to Register(target_register)
Translation performed with specified model and config
side_effects: Calls _t.translate() which may perform LLM API calls
May access or update _t internal caches

structured_side_effects.description: May update profile cache or detector state

functions.name: transmog_detect
functions.description: Detect the register of input text. Decorated as @mcp.tool() for MCP exposure. Uses Transmogrifier._detector.detect() and returns register value and confidence.
preconditions: _t (Transmogrifier instance) must be initialized in closure
postconditions: register is the .value attribute of detected Register enum
confidence is the numeric confidence score from detector

functions.name: transmog_profiles
functions.description: List all cached model register sensitivity profiles. Decorated as @mcp.tool() for MCP exposure. Returns serialized profile list from _t._profile_cache.
preconditions: _t (Transmogrifier instance) must be initialized in closure
postconditions: Returns list of dictionaries, each serialized from profile.model_dump()

invariants: Single shared Transmogrifier instance (_t) used by all tool functions
Tool functions are closures over _t, only accessible after main() execution
TranslationConfig() creates new instance per transmog_translate call

data_access.rationale: Reads detector and cache state via Transmogrifier instance. Writes occur indirectly through _t.translate() side effects.

side_effects.rationale: MCP server reads requests from stdin and writes responses to stdout
transmog_translate triggers LLM API calls via Transmogrifier.translate()
main() calls sys.exit(1) on import failure

authority.rationale: Server module, no data domain authority
